ingredients.name: Finely Chopped Tomatoes with Onion and Garlic
ingredients.buy: Finely Chopped Tomatoes with Onion and Garlic

points: Bring a large saucepan of water to the boil with 1/2 tsp salt.
When boiling, add the pasta to the water and bring back to the boil. Cook until tender, 12 mins.
Once cooked, drain in a colander and pop back into the pan. Drizzle with oil and stir through to stop it sticking together.
steps.title: Cook the Pasta

points: Halve, peel and chop the onion into small pieces. Peel and grate the garlic (or use a garlic press).
Halve the chilli lengthways, deseed, then finely chop. Set aside for garnishing later.
steps.title: Get Prepped

points: Heat a drizzle of oil in a frying pan on high heat.
Once hot, add the beef mince, mushrooms and onion. Fry until the beef is browned and the veg is tender, 5-6 mins.
Use a spoon to break up the mince as it cooks, then drain and discard any excess fat.
Stir in the garlic and cook for 1 min more.

notes.text: Wash your hands after handling raw mince. The mince is cooked when no longer pink in the middle.

steps.title: Fry the Beef

points: Add the chopped tomatoes (see ingredients for amount), red wine jus paste and water for the beef and sugar for the sauce (see pantry for both amounts) to the pan and stir to combine.
Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat and simmer until thickened, 8-10 mins.
steps.title: Make your Sauce

points: Once thickened, take the ragu from the heat and stir in the BBQ sauce. Season to taste with salt and pepper if needed.
Add the cooked pasta to the pan, mix well to combine, then remove from the heat.
Add a splash more water if you feel it needs it.
steps.title: Combine and Stir

points: Share the BBQ beef pasta between your bowls.
Sprinkle over the green chilli (add less if you'd prefer things milder).
steps.title: Serve
